dedupe_keys.name: ams ix traffic statistics daily monthly and yearly traffic of the amsterdam internet exchange

description: AMS-IX, one of the world's largest internet exchanges, publishes the traffic statistics of its Amsterdam platform on its website, with graphs of daily, monthly and yearly traffic and for each period the peak, average and current incoming and outgoing traffic; on 26 September 2026 the page showed a yearly peak of about 15.1 Tbit/s, a yearly average of about 9.4 Tbit/s, and 913 connected networks. AMS-IX also runs or powers exchanges in the Caribbean, Hong Kong, Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Singapore, Bangkok, Manila, Lagos, Djibouti, Cairo, Manama, Muscat and elsewhere, some with their own statistics pages. Coverage: the AMS-IX Amsterdam platform, with pages for other locations. Format and access: web graphs and figures, free to view under AMS-IX terms of use; no machine-readable export was found. Caveats: aggregate totals only, without per-member or per-route detail; graph images need digitising for analysis. Simulation uses: diurnal and seasonal load profiles of a major European exchange for capacity models, and evidence of traffic shifts during outages. Related records: the AMS-IX platform loop outages case study describes failures of this platform, and the DE-CIX and IX.br traffic statistics cover other large exchanges.
name: AMS-IX traffic statistics: daily, monthly and yearly traffic of the Amsterdam internet exchange
notes: Total stats page read with curl on 2026-09-26 (periods, values, member count, location list). PNG graph format assumed.
temporal_resolution: graph resolution from minutes to days
